posts.text:
Hi, my DKIM signing is able to pass various DKIM reflectors including port25 and sendmail.

However, the exact same messages sent to Yahoo fail as follows:

Authentication-Results: mta111.sbc.mail.mud.yahoo.com  from=circlid.com; domainkeys=neutral \(no sig\); from=; dkim=fail\(no sender headers detected\)

Appreciate any help\!

posts.text:
The section you cited \(5.7\) says the signature header field should be placed before any other DKIM-Signature. Since multiple signatures have to be supported as well I think the order of signature headers just describes the order of signing, but this shouldn't concern any validation result of a single signature in my view.

After mailing to Yahoo\! twice about the "no sender headers detected" topic it's interesting to see that they obviously don't check on dkim at time. I just can see a DomainKeys check result today:
Authentication-Results: mta220.mail.mud.yahoo.com  from=agitos.de; domainkeys=neutral \(no sig\)

I may be wrong with this observation but I'd wait until DKIM check results can be seen again and continue debugging then.

Hi,

I published v1.3 of DKIMforJavamail ... the sourceforge interface changed and I wonder why the new archive doesn't show up at https://sourceforge.net/projects/dkim-javamail/files/ yet -> I'll watch this.

v1.3 writes the signature to the first place in the header. I had to implement a small change only and the messages verify at Yahoo\! now.

Attention: the signature of the following method in DKIMSigner.java changed from
public void sign\(SMTPDKIMMessage message\) to
public String sign\(SMTPDKIMMessage message\); but this is transparent to a common implementor.

Thanks for your help, unfortuntely Yahoo\! itself took too long.
usrflo
